articles.title: Wildfires Rage Out of Control in Spain and France, Thousands Forced to Leave Homes
articles.summary: Large and dangerous wildfires have been burning across parts of Spain and France since last Thursday, and firefighters are struggling to bring the flames under control. In Spain, a major fire broke out near the capital Madrid, forcing many people living nearby to evacuate their homes. In France, the Gironde region is also dealing with an active wildfire. More than 30,000 people have had to leave their homes across the two countries. Authorities warned that very hot and dry weather, combined with strong winds, has made the fires extremely difficult to stop. Scientists say that climate change is making heatwaves and wildfires more frequent and intense in Europe each summer.

lv1: Where did the wildfires break out? (野火在哪裡爆發？)
What did people living near the fires have to do? (住在野火附近的居民需要做什麼？)
lv2: Why is it so difficult for firefighters to put out these wildfires? (為什麼消防員很難撲滅這些野火？)
How might climate change be connected to the worsening wildfires in Europe? (氣候變化與歐洲野火惡化有什麼關係？)
lv3: Some people argue that governments are not doing enough to prepare for wildfires caused by climate change. Do you agree? What more could be done? (有人認為各國政府在應對氣候變化引發的野火方面準備不足。你同意嗎？還可以做些什麼？)

If you lived near a wildfire zone, how would you feel about being evacuated? Should governments have the power to force people to leave their homes for safety reasons? (如果你住在野火區附近，被強制疏散時你會有什麼感受？政府是否應有權以安全理由強制市民離開家園？)

articles.title: Two Chinese Mathematicians Win the World's Top Maths Prize for the Very First Time
articles.summary: Two mathematicians from China, Wang Hong and Deng Yu, have both been awarded the Fields Medal — often described as the highest honour in mathematics. This is the first time in history that Chinese citizens have received this prestigious prize. Wang and Deng both graduated from Peking University as part of the class of 2007. The Fields Medal is awarded every four years to outstanding mathematicians under the age of 40. It is considered as important in the world of mathematics as the Nobel Prize is in science. Their achievement has been celebrated widely across China and has inspired many young students to take an interest in mathematics.

lv1: What is the name of the prize that Wang Hong and Deng Yu won? (王虹和鄧煜獲得了什麼獎項？)
Which university did both winners graduate from? (兩位得獎者都畢業於哪所大學？)
lv2: Why is winning the Fields Medal such a special achievement for China? (為什麼獲得菲爾茲獎對中國來說是如此特別的成就？)
The Fields Medal is only given to mathematicians under 40 years old. Why do you think there is an age limit for this prize? (菲爾茲獎只頒給40歲以下的數學家。你認為這個獎項設有年齡限制的原因是什麼？)
lv3: Does winning international prizes like the Fields Medal matter for a country's reputation in science and education? Why or why not? (贏得菲爾茲獎等國際獎項對一個國家在科學和教育方面的聲譽有多重要？為什麼？)
Some people say that school mathematics is too focused on memorising formulas rather than creative thinking. Do you think this needs to change? How? (有人認為學校數學教育過於注重死記公式，而忽略創意思維。你認為這需要改變嗎？應如何改變？)

articles.title: 唐山大地震50周年：回望1976年災難 中國悼念逾24萬名罹難者
articles.summary: 今日（7月28日）是1976年唐山大地震發生整整50周年。當年凌晨，一場強烈地震突然襲擊中國河北省唐山市，造成逾24萬人罹難，被列為20世紀全球死亡人數最多的地震之一。唐山地震遺址紀念公園今日舉行悼念活動，讓市民緬懷在災難中失去的生命。地震不僅奪走無數生命，更令整座城市幾乎夷為平地。唐山其後重建，今日已發展成現代化城市。這場災難令中國大力加強地震監測及防災工作，提醒世人防災教育的重要性。

lv1: 唐山大地震發生在哪一年？
唐山大地震大約造成多少人罹難？
lv2: 唐山大地震對中國的防災工作帶來了什麼影響？
為什麼我們需要記念像唐山大地震這樣的歷史災難？
lv3: 政府和社會應如何在發展城市的同時，加強防備天然災害的能力？
面對不可預測的自然災害，個人、學校和政府各自應承擔什麼責任？

articles.title: 匹克球掀運動熱潮！康文署今起推新租場安排 方便市民預訂
articles.summary: 匹克球（Pickleball）是一種結合網球、羽毛球和乒乓球特點的運動，近年在香港愈來愈受歡迎，吸引不少市民參與。為回應市民需求，康樂及文化事務署（康文署）由今日（7月28日）起，為匹克球場地推出全新租場安排，方便市民更容易預訂場地。匹克球規則簡單，場地比網球場小，適合不同年齡人士參與，包括長者及青少年。專家指出，多元化的運動選擇有助提升市民健康，而新的租場安排有望令更多人有機會嘗試這項新興運動。

lv1: 匹克球結合了哪幾種運動的特點？
哪個政府部門推出了匹克球的新租場安排？
lv2: 為什麼匹克球特別適合不同年齡的人士參與？
政府提供更多運動場地，對市民的健康有什麼好處？
lv3: 香港政府應如何決定優先發展哪些運動設施？你認為資源應如何分配給不同的運動？
有人認為香港市區運動設施不足，難以應付市民需求。你認為政府和私人機構應如何合作解決這個問題？
